status: declared/synthetic policy layer (envelope-not-actor); conditions the D3 base weights multiplicatively, never re-derives them. FINALISED at R2 (Marc greenlit 2026-07-23).
value_semantics: overlay_v(a->b) in [0,1] = given the attacker's action at tactic a came back v (success|failure), the likelihood of b as the next move — 0 = will not happen, 1 = the most likely next course of action. Authored ground-up per directed pair from tactic-pair semantics (kill-chain relationship, capability enablement, foothold dependency) + incident AARs.
composition_rule: at a source place a whose action returned verdict v: w'(a->b) = base(a->b) * overlay_v(a->b) / sum_b'[base(a->b') * overlay_v(a->b')]. The existing (base) edges are manipulated by the verdict; the source place's out-set renormalises so it stays a distribution.
coverage: this file materialises the 123 corpus-present pairs; the overlay is authored over the COMPLETE 210 directed tactic-pair set (corpus-agnostic) in the rule-based notation (see canonical_source). Which pairs route mass is a base/net property, not an overlay one.
evidence_tiers: success is the more grounded side (the `enables` relations come from MITRE tactic semantics and the get-in/spread patterns the DFIR/Sophos AARs document); failure is declared judgement (incident reports document what worked, not what an attacker does when a step fails). The two sit at different evidential tiers by construction — stated, not hidden.

model.success_rule: enabled -> 1.0; else forward 0.6 / lateral 0.5 / backward 0.25 (0.1 if regressing to a band-0 pre-intrusion tactic)
model.failure_rule: gates: initial-access failure -> foothold-dependent dst 0.02 (soft-floor, ~45:1; recon bridge dominates); recon failure -> deep dst 0.05, initial-access 0.4. dampers: post-intrusion backward->pre-foothold dst 0.25 (exempts the initial-access->reconnaissance=0.9 bridge); backward->execution 0.35 (re-running code on a held foothold is a forward-level continuation). else backward 0.9 / lateral 0.7 / forward 0.35 (0.30 if source is pre-foothold)

canonical_source: RULE-BASED notation is now canonical: data/ogasp/controller/outcome_rules.json (model + ordered rules, one rationale each) + compiled complete views success.json/failure.json (all 210 directed pairs). This file is the corpus-scoped (123-pair) view, regenerated from the same R2 rules.
scrutiny: R2 converged through 4 adversarial cross-examination rounds (~90 agents): CTI-independence PASS (make_rules reads only bands/enables/foothold; the corpus is failure-blind so the failure side cannot be circular); composed-net validation on build_all_profiles(with_synthetic_overlay=True); stepwise simulation (real nets, stubbed MTDSim verdict) found the option-sets plausible and the finetune synthesis returned ZERO changes. Certified confidence 82% (panel 82/82/82/84/88); the 82->95% remainder is the dissertation defence, not value uncertainty. Provenance ledger: docs/implementation/declared_value_provenance.md. Each R2 constant: base only DIAGNOSED a coherence failure; the value is set from declared semantics (never a fitting target).
